```{r}
library(MetaCycle)
library(tidyverse)
```



```{r}
dat <- read.csv("../Processed_Data/VST.csv")
timepoints <- seq(2, 47, 3)
out <- meta2d(infile = "../Processed_Data/VST.csv",
              outdir = "../Processed_Data/metacycle",
              filestyle = "csv",
              timepoints = timepoints)
```

```{r}
ls_dat <- read.csv("../Processed_Data/full_ls.csv")[, -1]
meta_dat <- read.csv("../Processed_Data/metacycle/meta2d_VST.csv")
```

Q1: overlap of oscillating in ls_dat vs circadian in meta_dat
```{r}
osc <- ls_dat %>% filter(fap <= 0.05)
meta_cir <- meta_dat %>% filter(meta2d_BH.Q <= 0.05)
meta_cir_ls <- meta_dat %>% filter(LS_pvalue <= 0.05)

sum(osc$GeneID %in% meta_cir$CycID) #shared
sum(!(osc$GeneID %in% meta_cir$CycID)) #OSC only
sum(!(meta_cir$CycID %in% osc$GeneID)) #meta only

osc_only <- osc[!(osc$GeneID %in% meta_cir$CycID),]
hist(osc_only$best_period)

sum(osc$GeneID %in% meta_cir_ls$CycID) #shared
sum(!(osc$GeneID %in% meta_cir_ls$CycID)) #OSC only
sum(!(meta_cir_ls$CycID %in% osc$GeneID)) #meta only

meta_only <- ls_dat %>% filter(ls_dat$GeneID %in% meta_cir[!(meta_cir$CycID %in% osc$GeneID),]$CycID)
```

So my ls found more than meta_dat's ls (maybe due to pval vs qval?)
metacycle found more than my ls.
All the 24hr found by my ls is found by meta, but my ls included other oscillation periods while metacycle is locked to 20~28
